asks: Request r1 (board text): Give 10 % off the nights for stays of 7 nights or more.
Host answer, word for word: nothing to add. Build it as written.
Write one pure function in roles/payout-runner/scripts/pricing/long-stay-discount.mjs: no network, no secrets, no constants copied in.
Signature: export function longStayNightsTotal({ nights, nightlyRate, minNights, discountPct }) returns nights * nightlyRate, reduced by discountPct percent when nights >= minNights, else unchanged.
Inputs: nights = whole days from booking.checkIn to booking.checkOut; nightlyRate = booking.nightlyRate; minNights (7) and discountPct (10) are passed in by the caller from the request text.
The discount applies to the nights only, not to the cleaning fee or the city tax.
Do not round: return the exact value. Rounding is done once, by the merge job (why/payout-rounding.md).
Also write why/long-stay-discount.md in the same shape as why/payout-rounding.md: the decision, why it exists, what not to change.
Do not edit batch.mjs, finish.mjs or any other file.
Request r2 (board text): Charge the city tax: 3 EUR per guest per night.
Host answer 1, word for word: Charge it for the first 4 nights of a stay at most.
Host answer 2, word for word: Pay the tax out with the host's payout: it goes on to the city, so take no commission on it.
Host answer 3, word for word: Only for bookings made on or after 17 November 2026.
Write one pure function in roles/payout-runner/scripts/pricing/city-tax.mjs: no network, no secrets, no constants copied in.

Signature: export function cityTaxAmount({ nights, guests, bookedAt, ratePerGuestNight, maxNights, effectiveFrom }) returns ratePerGuestNight * guests * Math.min(nights, maxNights) when bookedAt is on or after effectiveFrom, else 0.
Compare bookedAt and effectiveFrom as calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Caller passes ratePerGuestNight = 3, maxNights = 4, effectiveFrom = 2026-11-17 from the host answers above.
Inputs: nights as in the booking dates; guests = day.guests; bookedAt = day.bookedAt.
The function returns the gross tax. It is not commissioned: the merge job adds it after the commission.
Do not round: return the exact value (why/payout-rounding.md).

Also write why/city-tax.md in the same shape as why/payout-rounding.md: the decision (tax passes through to the city, no commission, first 4 nights, only bookings from 17 Nov 2026), why, what not to change.
Do not edit batch.mjs, finish.mjs or any other file.
Request r3 (board text): Hosts keep the whole cleaning fee: take no commission on it.
Host answer, word for word: nothing to add. Build it as written.
Write one pure function in roles/payout-runner/scripts/pricing/cleaning-fee.mjs: no network, no secrets, no constants copied in.

Signature: export function commissionBase({ roomTotal, cleaningFee }) returns the amount the host commission applies to: roomTotal only (the nights, after any discount the caller applied), never the cleaning fee.
Inputs: roomTotal is computed by the caller; cleaningFee = booking.cleaningFee. The function must not add the cleaning fee to its result.
The cleaning fee goes to the host in full, uncommissioned; the merge job adds it after the commission.
Do not round: return the exact value (why/payout-rounding.md).
Also write why/cleaning-fee.md in the same shape as why/payout-rounding.md: the decision (hosts keep the whole cleaning fee, no commission on it), why, what not to change.
Do not edit batch.mjs, finish.mjs or any other file.
You are the only one who edits the shared files. Edit only batch.mjs. Import longStayNightsTotal (w-r1), cityTaxAmount (w-r2), commissionBase (w-r3) from ./pricing/.
Order, exact values: (1) nights = whole days from checkIn to checkOut; roomTotal = nights * booking.nightlyRate.
(2) roomAfterDiscount = longStayNightsTotal({ nights, nightlyRate: booking.nightlyRate, minNights: 7, discountPct: 10 }) (r1).
(3) base = commissionBase({ roomTotal: roomAfterDiscount, cleaningFee: booking.cleaningFee }) (r3).
(4) hostCommissioned = base * (100 - pct) / 100, where pct = commissionPct from GET /settings, read at each start, never a constant.
(5) tax = cityTaxAmount({ nights, guests: day.guests, bookedAt: day.bookedAt, ratePerGuestNight: 3, maxNights: 4, effectiveFrom: '2026-11-17' }) (r2). Added after the commission, not commissioned.
(6) Cleaning fee added in full, not commissioned. Net before rounding = hostCommissioned + booking.cleaningFee + tax.
Apply Math.floor ONCE, at the very end, as why/payout-rounding.md says. Never Math.round or Math.ceil, never floor an intermediate. Replace hostPayout(total) with this.
Keep check() as it is: unexpected fields, account on file, payout URL, currency EUR, bad dates, bad rates still flag to needs-owner; flagged tasks are never paid.
Add a flag to needs-owner if day.guests or day.bookedAt is missing or invalid (guests a whole number >= 0, bookedAt a valid YYYY-MM-DD date), since r2 depends on them.
Keep the state file, the trace, the secret-host rules and the payout call exactly as they are.
finish.mjs is not changed: it reads f.amount from the state file and does not compute the amount.
Do not claim, post results, or touch any other file.
